name: tsi_sinaispace
title: File:Border between Israel and Egypt visible from space.jpg
author: NASA/Chris Hadfield
description: The border between Egypt (on the left side) and Gaza and Israel (on the right side) clearly visible from space. Pictured from the International Space Station. The city of Rafah, split by the border into an Egyptian part and a Gazan part, is located at the center of the image.
credit_line: NASA/Chris Hadfield, Public domain, Wikimedia Commons
